result: verified
Your swing has one verified fault: early extension. Between address and impact
your hips moved toward the ball by 7% of your body height. The rule flags anything
over 4%, so this is a clear reading. When the hips move toward the ball, your
upper body has to stand up to make room for your arms, which makes solid contact
harder. The likely cause is restricted hip rotation: at impact your lead hip had
turned 31°, where about 45° is typical, so the hips slide forward because they
cannot turn. It may feel like you stay down, but at impact your hips have moved
toward the ball. Practise the wall drill to feel your trail glute stay back, and
use the 90/90 hip rotation to free up the turn.

svg.text: Written from this analysis only: M-01, M-02, R-EE, D-01, X-01. No other numbers.

text.tspan: Set up with your backside
touching a wall (or a golf
bag). Make slow half swings,
keeping your trail glute on
the wall through impact.
Check: if the glute leaves
the wall, the hips moved
toward the ball (M-01).

svg.text: X-01 · MOBILITY · for the likely cause

text.tspan: Sit with both knees bent
at 90°. Rotate slowly to
face the other side and
back, keeping your chest
tall.
Generic guidance, not medical advice — see a
physiotherapist if you feel pain.

rory 18:46
Why does it feel like I'm staying down
when I'm not?
Feel and position often disagree, and I can
only measure position. Between address and
impact your hips moved toward the ball by 7%
of your body height [M-01], almost twice
the 4% threshold. In the impact frame [F-IMP]
your hip marker sits ahead of the dashed line
where it started. The wall drill [D-01] turns
this into a feel check: if your trail glute leaves
the wall, your hips have moved toward the ball.
rory 18:48
Is my grip causing this?
This analysis does not measure grip, so I
can't tell you. Nothing in it links grip to
early extension. A coach can check your grip
in person.

svg.text: How do I know the drill is working?
Can I do this drill in a net?

text.tspan: The coach explains; the rule table decides. It cannot
change a finding or a confidence band. The console
stays pinned beside the result while you scroll.
